Others become part of your soul.

Through every lonely night.
Through every road that takes you somewhere new.
Through every moment you convince yourself you've finally moved on.

I still feel you...

Deep inside my soul.

I can hide the photographs.

I can leave the places we once knew.

I can build an entirely different life...

But there's one place I can never remove you from.

Deep inside my soul.

For the hearts still carrying someone they once loved.
For the dreamers who believe some connections survive every goodbye.
For anyone who has ever discovered that moving forward doesn't always mean forgetting.

Close your eyes.
Feel every memory.
Follow the emotion.

And remember the one who will always remain...

snippet.title: Silvia Infantas Y Los Condores - La Consentida (Lyric Video)
snippet.description:
"La Consentida", interpretada magistralmente por Silvia Infantas y Los Condores, es considerada la cueca más trascendental y popular de la historia musical chilena. Aunque la autoría pertenece a Jaime Atria, quien la compuso en 1961 inspirado en su musa Alicia Rosselot, la versión grabada por Silvia Infantas elevó la pieza a la categoría de himno nacional indiscutido, convirtiéndose en el repertorio central de cada Fiestas Patrias.
